name: Chicken Potsticker Bake with Bok Choy, Hoisin-Coconut Sauce & Sriracha

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
4 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic (reserving a small handful for serving).

Add coconut milk, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, oil, fish sauce, and pepper to the bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce, then pour half into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. (Reserve remaining sauce for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tsp fish sauce
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange potstickers, flat-side down, in the sauce.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add to the baking dish (distributing them evenly over the potstickers), then drizzle with reserved sauce. Cover baking dish with aluminum foil.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until potstickers start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

When the potstickers have started to soften, remove baking dish from oven. Discard foil, stir the potstickers, then return baking dish to the oven. Continue to bake until potstickers are cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly, 20 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide potstickers and rice between plates or bowls, drizzle with sriracha, and sprinkle with reserved green onions. Enjoy!
